phone_token = _mem['s9']['access_token']
coworkers = []
roommates = []

# Fetch coworkers
page = 0
while True:
    res = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, relationship='coworker', page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not res:
        break
    coworkers.extend(res)
    if len(res) < 20:
        break
    page += 1

page = 0

    res = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, relationship='roommate', page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not res:
        break
    roommates.extend(res)
    if len(res) < 20:
        break
    page += 1

print(f"coworkers: {len(coworkers)}")
print(f"roommates: {len(roommates)}")

print("Roommate emails:", [c['email'] for c in roommates])
